evals.prompt: Split this billing feature into stacked PRs
evals.expected_output: Uses gh stack to create layered branches for models, API, and UI
assertions: Checks that repository is on GitHub
Runs quality gates per layer before submit

evals.prompt: I need to stack these changes across multiple concerns
evals.expected_output: Creates a stack with topic-prefixed branches and submits draft PRs
assertions: References atomic-commit as the default alternative

evals.prompt: Create a gh stack for the auth feature with schema, API, and tests layers
evals.expected_output: Initializes a 3-layer stack with named branches
assertions: Uses gh stack init with explicit branch names
Implements bottom-up (schema first, then API, then tests)

evals.prompt: This is a small bug fix in one file
evals.expected_output: Does NOT use stacked PRs — uses atomic-commit instead
assertions: Recognizes single-concern work does not need stacking
Does not invoke gh stack commands

evals.prompt: Fix CI on a stacked branch
evals.expected_output: Uses self-fix-loop with stacked-PR safety: new commits only, gh stack rebase --upstack, gh stack push
assertions: Does not amend commits on stacked branches
Uses gh stack push instead of git push --force
